svg.title: 太極八卦與兩儀四象生成圖
svg.desc: 繁體中文與英文雙語圖解。左為先天八卦方位：上乾、右上巽、右坎、右下艮、下坤、左下震、左離、左上兌。右為太極、兩儀、四象、八卦及口訣。全部文字與圖形均為向量路徑。

g.aria-label: Two Modes · Four Images · Eight Trigrams
I Ching · The Great Commentary, Part I
「是故易有太極，是生兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，
八卦定吉凶，吉凶生大業。」
Thus, in the Changes there is the Supreme Ultimate, which gives rise to the Two Modes.
The Two Modes give rise to the Four Images; the Four Images give rise to the Eight Trigrams.
The Eight Trigrams determine good fortune and misfortune;
good fortune and misfortune give rise to great undertakings.
